description_en: Retrieves a list of partition names for a data lake table
description_zh: 调用此API可获取数据湖表分区名列表
kebab_example: aliyun dms list-data-lake-partition-name --tid 30000 --catalog-name hive --db-name default --table-name table_name --next-token f056501ada120000 --max-results 20 --workspace-id 120000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataLakePartitionName

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.

Hover over your profile picture in the upper-right corner of the DMS console to obtain the tenant ID. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog
parameters.name: catalog_name

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first call.

If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query is needed.

If NextToken has a return value, it is the token to start the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100
parameters.name: max_results
